title: Phaseo · Jobs and settlement
description: Completion means the handler returned; inspect item failures separately. Skipped jobs are distinct. Financial truth remains in Supabase.

targets.expr: sum by (job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | outcome="completed" [$__auto]))

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

targets.expr: sum by (job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | outcome="error" [$__auto]))

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.95, {service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", duration_ms="duration_ms", job="job" | __error__="" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [$__auto]) by (job)

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

targets.expr: sum by (job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | outcome="skipped" [$__auto]))

matcher.options: ^(error|.* · error|Gateway actionable|Web API 5xx|Website server errors|Operational failures|Server errors|Delivery failures)$

panels.title: Job execution results
panels.description: Selected-range invocation counts by outcome. Zero means no observed events for that outcome among jobs with received runs. Completed means the handler returned; disabled/skipped jobs are distinct. This does not measure backlog or data freshness.

targets.expr: (sum by (service_name, job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | outcome="completed" | __error__="" [$__range]))) or (0 * (sum by (service_name, job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))))

(sum by (service_name, job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | outcome="error" | __error__="" [$__range]))) or (0 * (sum by (service_name, job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))))

(sum by (service_name, job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | outcome="skipped" | __error__="" [$__range]))) or (0 * (sum by (service_name, job) (count_over_time({service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | __error__="" [$__range]))))

panels.title: Failed job records
panels.description: Newest 100 failed invocations. Known item failures appear when the job explicitly emits them; arbitrary internally handled errors are not inferred.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job", outcome="outcome" | __error__="" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | outcome="error"

panels.title: Operational failures
panels.description: Newest 100 existing settlement and usage persistence failures. Inspect the source hook and request before taking action. No balances, prompts or customer identities are exported.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"phaseo-gateway"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job" | __error__="" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="ops.failure"

panels.title: Recent job runs
panels.description: Newest 100 job invocations. Completed means the handler returned; missing item counts stay unavailable, not zero. Skipped jobs are distinct from failed jobs.

targets.expr: {service_name=~"phaseo-jobs|phaseo-web-api"} | json environment="environment", event_name="event_name", job="job" | __error__="" | job=~".*${job:regex}.*" | environment="$environment" | event_name="job.run"
